# Mezzo

> Mezzo is a free, open-source, and ad-free music streaming platform and Android application that serves as a high-fidelity alternative to Spotify. It provides studio-grade lossless FLAC audio (up to 24-bit / 192kHz), real-time synchronized karaoke lyrics, a 10-band studio equalizer, and 1-click offline music downloads.

## Core Features & Capabilities

- **Lossless Hi-Res Streaming**: Uncompressed 24-bit / 192kHz FLAC, 320kbps AAC/MP3/OPUS streaming with zero ads and zero subscriptions.
- **Offline Backup & Download**: Instant 1-click offline music caching to local storage (IndexedDB on Web, Native filesystem on Android).
- **Synchronized Lyrics**: High-precision, real-time scrolling karaoke lyrics with interactive timecode seeking.
- **10-Band Studio Equalizer**: Precision Web Audio API biquad equalizer with acoustic presets (Bass Boost, Vocal Booster, Lo-Fi, Rock, Pop, Classical).
- **Personalized Music Discovery**: Multi-language support (Hindi, Punjabi, South Indian, English, Global Hits) with custom artist onboarding and mood feeds.
- **Cross-Platform Availability**: 
  - Android Native App (APK): ~3.4 MB lightweight native build.
  - Progressive Web App (PWA): Standalone installable web player for macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS.

## Quick Links

- Web Player: https://mezzo-music.pages.dev/
- Landing Page: https://mezzo-music.pages.dev/landing
- Android APK: https://mezzo-music.pages.dev/Mezzo-1.0.apk
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/sanir321/mezzo

## Technical Architecture

- Frontend: SvelteKit 5 (Runes), TailwindCSS, TypeScript.
- Mobile Shell: Capacitor Native Android Bridge.
- Edge Infrastructure: Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare D1.
- Audio Engine: HTML5 Web Audio API, Biquad Filter Nodes, MediaSession API.
